title: Erdős–Szekeres bound on Ramsey numbers
statement:
For integers $k, l \ge 1$, the Ramsey number $r(k, l)$ — the least $n$ such that every simple graph on $n$ vertices contains either a clique on $k$ vertices or an independent set on $l$ vertices — satisfies
\[
r(k, l) \le \binom{k + l - 2}{k - 1}.
\]
replaced:
\texttt{r(k, l) $\le$ C(k + l - 2, k - 1)}.

$\quad r(k, l) \leq \binom{k + l - 2}{k - 1}$
